comment: Read from the installed 2.0.5 build. The switch labels are read verbatim from Q119A::Q119A: Mode is 1x24 or 3x8, and the panel prints the others as OUTPUTS -5/+5 or 0/+5, CYCLE ONCE or CONT, SEQUENCE UP or UP/DOWN, SOURCE EXT or INT and RANGE HIGH or LOW. The rate knob is configured 2 to 20 and the gate width 0.1 to 0.9. The module is monophonic: its channel count is never taken from an input. Q119A_process is two thousand instructions long and was not read through, so no clock rate figures are quoted.
